name: earnings_surprise_regime_aware
_doc: RECOMMENDED forward-return ranking score. The ONLY signal that survives the investable-universe restriction (drop smallest ~30%) without collapsing to a microcap artifact. Economically = PEAD / post-earnings-announcement drift. Best at +20d. Regime-aware decision layer (see _regime_gate) downweights in down/panic regimes where the long bucket goes negative.

_regime_gate.doc: Decision-layer multiplier on EXPOSURE (not a sign flip; scaling never changes within-date ranking). Realized OOS top-decile excess by regime at +10d: up_calm +0.0057, up_turbulent +0.0064, down_calm -0.0036, down_turbulent -0.0015.

_upgrade_path: Add forecast/express (业绩预告/快报) earlier-timing surprise (prior T2-7): official-report SUE is partly pre-priced by earlier announcements; earlier-timing surprise should strengthen the signal. Highest-ROI next feature.
